q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of hard boiled candy per kg?
title: Candy carbon footprint per kg
short: Add the sugar, glucose syrup and flavours per kg with supplier figures, then the cooking, forming and wrapping energy. Divide the plant's fuel and electricity by kg packed and add the wrapper film and cartons.

ul: Sugar and liquid glucose by weight.
Air conditioning for the packing hall.

p: Report per kg of candy, then per piece using the count per kg. Sugar usually carries most of the ingredient footprint.

example.title: Worked example: candy unit per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 40,700 / 300,000 = 0.136 kg CO2 per kg
Add sugar, glucose and wrappers for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
